questions.subject: EUROPEAN_HISTORY
questions.topic: How the settlement fed the crash

stimulus.body: A historian notes that reparations, war debts, and tariff walls together strained the postwar economy. When credit contracted, these pressures converged into a global downturn.

questions.stem: A translator's note reviews a synthesis source; what does it show?

options.text: A single factor caused the crash
The settlement had no economic role
Multiple settlement pressures converged into crisis

questions.explanation: The source shows multiple pressures converging. The tempting single-factor or no-role claims contradict the text.
